_comment: NED name-resolution configuration for SPARC labels NED's bare-name interpreter rejects. Three optional sections, in order of precedence at lookup time: 1) exact alias (`alias_map`): {SPARC_name -> NED-resolvable canonical query string}. Highest priority. 2) Pattern rules (`pattern_rules`): list of {`regex`, `ned_query_template`} entries. The first regex that matches the SPARC name via `re.fullmatch` produces a templated query (`{name}` is substituted by the original SPARC label). Use this for systematic prefixing of catalogues (Schombert LSB, ESO low-surface-brightness, etc.). 3) Generic permutation prefixes (`ned_prefix_attempts`): ordered list of strings tried verbatim as `f"{prefix}{name}"`. The empty string is always inserted at position 0 to ensure the bare name is tried first. Keys starting with `_` are ignored by the loader; you may add `_doc` fields for human notes.

pattern_rules._doc: Schombert LSB catalogue labels (F-prefix, three digits, dash, suffix): NED needs the explicit `LSB ` qualifier to disambiguate from other F-prefixed catalogues.
